messages:
anya: Quick sync 1:0 SableWorks case study interview booked Tue Apr 8 10:30am PT. Deliverables: short blog, 30s promo, product testimonial on page. Need quote + logo rights by Mon Apr 7 EOD.

rory: I'll run recording. Will capture mic test, local backup, and a clean 16:9 & 4:3 speaker frame for hero.

jess: I'll send the quote + logo request to Lina now. Using template: 
> Hi Lina 1 thanks again. Can you confirm the quote below and confirm we can use SableWorks logo (SVG) on the post and product page? Also can you confirm the 18% stat is publishable?

anya: Draft quote: 
"Redwood let us ship live summarization quickly and cut average support handle time by 18%." 1 Lina R., Head of Product, SableWorks

marie: Legal quick note: don't publish any customer metrics without a written approval line. If they approve, include "Approved for public release by SableWorks, [date]" in the post footer.

jess: Sent DM to Lina. Will paste reply here.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach written approval to the case folder for audit (legal@redwood.example).

rory: Also adding chapters to the recording to speed clip extraction (intro, demo, metrics, closing).

jess: Lina replied: "We approve the quote and the 18% stat. Attaching SVG. Please embargo publish until Apr 15 to align with partner announcement." Pasting file link: /shared/marketing/sableworks/logo.svg

marie: Received the approval text. I'll log it and sign off once copy is final. Footer to add: "Approved for public release by SableWorks, Apr 15 2025."

anya: Timeline recap: send request (done), legal sign-off (Marie), interview Apr 8 (Rory), draft post Apr 10, schedule publish Apr 15 embargo. Any blockers?

rory: None from recording side. I'll upload clips/chapter marks to the drive after call.

jess: I'll queue the draft as soon as I have rough cuts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

(End thread 1 assets and notes in /shared/marketing/sableworks)
